messages:
Lina (People Ops): quick heads-up — we’ve finalized two short policy updates that go into effect Apr 1. TL;DR: PTO accrual alignment for international FT employees + a contractor accrual pilot, and an Emergency Caregiver Leave pilot (up to 10 days) + updated travel safety attestation. More below. :sparkles:

Maya (People Ops): full FAQ + implementation notes here: https://intranet.redwood/hr/pto-updates-apr2026 — please read before town hall.

Jamal R.: will this change how accrual hits payroll cutoff for EMEA folks?

Lina (People Ops): good Q — payroll timing stays the same. Accrual rates change starting Apr 1 payroll. No retro pay adjustments, but we’ll provide a one-time statement showing the delta for transparency.

Sofia L.: what’s the contractor pilot look like? does it affect contractors on SOWs now?

Maya (People Ops): contractor pilot applies to long-term contractors (≥6 months) and is opt-in for the team lead + contractor. Pilot accrual: 4 hours/month for eligible contractors during Q2. We’ll evaluate in July and share metrics.

Lina (People Ops): snippet of the new accrual matrix:
```
Region           | Accrual rate (hrs/month)
-------------------------------------
US / Canada      | 8
EMEA             | 6.7
APAC             | 6
Contractor pilot | 4 (opt-in, Q2 only)
```

Tomas V.: Emergency Caregiver Leave — is that separate from PTO bank or carved out?

Maya (People Ops): separate carve-out. Up to 10 days of Emergency Caregiver Leave per rolling 12 months, does not reduce PTO. Use-case examples: sudden hospitalization of dependent, immediate childcare breakdown, etc. Managers don’t need documentation upfront; People Ops may follow up after leave starts.

Lina (People Ops): travel safety attestation update — if you’re traveling internationally on Redwood business, you’ll be asked to complete a short attestation confirming awareness of local health/travel advisories and emergency contacts. This is part of our Duty of Care obligations. No change to personal travel policies.

Sofia L.: will there be language for offer letters for contractors?

Maya (People Ops): yes — Legal and People Ops updated the SOW template. Recruiting & Eng managers will get a changelog this afternoon.

Lina (People Ops): we’ve scheduled a short town hall to walk teams through changes and answer Qs: <https://meet.redwood.com/townhall-apr2|Town Hall — Apr 2, 10:00 PT>. Recording will be posted. :calendar:

Jamal R.: thanks — can we get an example scenario for caregiver leave use?

Maya (People Ops): sure — we’ll post 3 short scenarios in the FAQ doc and add a one-slide decision checklist for managers.

HR-Bot: Reminder set: Town Hall — Apr 2, 10:00 PT (link above). RSVP required.

Lina (People Ops): action items for managers: 1) review FAQ with your teams this week; 2) if you manage contractors, confirm who is eligible for the pilot by Mar 25; 3) escalate any special accommodations to People Ops. Thanks all — ping @Maya or @Lina if you need anything before the town hall. :handshake:
